label: TXWG Group 6
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions

ground_removed.flood: 4-neighbour flood from the picture's edge over pixels within 10 levels of the ground colour and the ground alpha

band.rule: alpha from the pixel colour's place between the ground colour and the outline's solid colour, colour taken from the outline

provenance: CAP Brand Tools repository (CAP subordinate graphic generator), Roman Vitanza; emblemoptions.js entry "TXWG Group 6" (Group), path group/swrtx060.png. Official digital artwork shipped as given: png; trimmed to its alpha bounding box only (239 x 229 px to 239 x 229 px), no resampling, no colour change. On 2026-11-12, at the owner's request, the ground that came around the emblem (white at half opacity; 25070 px, found by a flood from the picture's edge) was made clear, and the 1310 px where the outline had been blended into it (up to 3 px deep) were given their alpha from where their colour lies between the ground colour and the outline's own solid colour (#fcb72c, #e1be4a) and took that colour, and the picture was trimmed again to the emblem's box (239 x 229 px to 203 x 204 px); no resampling, no redrawing, no other colour change.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The ground around the emblem was made clear on 2026-11-12 (the owner: background removed from the patches), nothing else was changed.
